input:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production large nine-slice-safe physical slot-machine display bezel for a premium portrait mobile casino game
Primary request: create one original wide rounded rectangular cabinet bezel for headers, lobby displays, rules and payout panels; it must look like a substantial molded part of a real luxury slot machine, not a thin picture frame and not a small button enlarged
Subject: medium-thick flowing champagne-gold structural molding, a deep warm burgundy glass outer band, ivory-enamel inset rails, one continuous track of small pearl marquee bulbs, and restrained blank coin studs integrated into the long top and bottom rails; corners flow smoothly into the side rails with small pearl clusters, never separate medallions
Style/medium: photorealistic high-end 3D commercial casino cabinet hardware, believable molded metal, enamel, glass and pearl materials, tactile depth, soft festive wealth
Composition/framing: exact front orthographic view, perfect bilateral symmetry, 3:2 landscape canvas; rounded capsule-like rectangular bezel occupies about 90 percent canvas width and 76 percent height; generous fully open center; compact flowing corners; top, bottom, left and right contain long quiet straight repeatable middle sections for nine-slice scaling
Scene/backdrop: one perfectly flat uniform electric blue #0000FF chroma-key background edge to edge, visible outside and through the full central opening; no texture, no gradient, no shadow, no horizon
Lighting/mood: warm diffused casino marquee light, crisp yet soft metal bevel highlights, pearl glow, prosperous and cheerful, inviting rather than royal or solemn
Color palette: champagne gold, soft rose gold, warm ivory enamel, deep burgundy glass, pearl white, tiny restrained ruby and emerald pin lights
Materials/textures: polished and brushed metal, thick molded enamel, translucent burgundy glass, nacreous pearls, blank embossed gold coin studs
Constraints: no text, no letters, no numerals, no logos, no watermark, no currency symbols; no blue on the bezel; no cast shadow or glow contaminating blue; clean hard silhouette; entire center remains empty blue; decorations confined to bezel; nine-slice-safe straight rail runs
Avoid: thin picture frame, giant round corner coins, isolated corner discs, palace architecture, tall columns, oversized crown, wings, dominant gems, button proportions, flat yellow line, black or red drop shadow, dark severe mood, scenery, characters
